title: S force triangular fire team trained on Murchison ranch in Mexico
place_text: Fort Huachuca, Arizona / Mexico ranch of Clint Murchison Jr.

tellings.quote: So they set up a triangular fire team base down there to to practice shooting a moving target from three different locations

plain: Between 1960 and 1963, a team linked to Fort Huachuca, an Army base in Arizona, supposedly set up a base on the Mexico ranch of the Texas oilman Clint Murchison Jr. There it trained a 'triangular fire team' to practise shooting a moving target from three different spots at once. The lawyer Dan Sheehan tells Michels this while talking about the killing of President Kennedy. He names Carl Jenkins and the mob boss Santo Trafficante Jr. but gives no source. If true, it would suggest the shooting in Dallas was rehearsed ahead of time by an organised group.
